title: What are Gemini Gems? And how to use them
summary: Gemini Gems let you build your own custom chatbots using natural language. Here's a detailed guide on how to create, edit, duplicate, and delete Gemini Gems.
body_markdown: Zapier is the most connected AI orchestration platform—integrating with thousands of apps from partners like Google, Salesforce, and Microsoft.
